headline: Clinton order changes the rules for the National Partnership Council, which advised on how federal agencies and their unions work together.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12871, the 1993 order that set up the National Partnership Council. That council advised the President on labor-management relations in the federal government. The title does not say exactly what was changed, such as who sits on the council or what it does.

who_it_affects.how: The council deals with how federal workers' unions and agency managers cooperate, so changes to it may affect how their concerns are heard.
Managers take part in the labor-management partnerships the council oversees, so changes to the council may affect their role.
